procedural_matters: NED 8929 was represented by Jildou van Grinsven.
SUI 9084 was represented by Albert Wells.
ITA 7882 was represented by Samuele Bardelli.
EST 9158 was represented by Ella Marie Kangur.
EST 9169 was represented by Helena Lee Kangur.
GBR 6273 and the race committee did not attend the hearing, the hearing proceeded in accordance with RRS 63.1(b).
NED 8929, EST 9158 and EST 9169 declared at the beginning of the hearing that they also wanted to file a request for redress.
Maud Lodewijk attended the haering as an interpreter for NED 8929.
facts: Protest time limit for race 1 of the red fleet of RS Feva was 22.07.2026, 16:51.
The results of race 1 were published on 22.07.2026.
SUI 9084, ITA 7882, EST 9158 and EST 9169 filed scoring enquiries on the evening of 22.07.2026, which were rejected the same evening.
NED 8929 saw the results on the evening of 22.07.2026, and filed a scoring enquiry on 23.07.2026 before racing.
All requests for redress were loged after racing on 23.07.2026.
conclusions: NED 8929, SUI 9084, ITA 7882, EST 9158 and EST 9169 failed to deliver the request for redress within the protest time limit or two hours afterthe incident, as required by RRS 61.2(b)(1).
There was no good reason for the International Juryto extend the time.
decision: The request for redress is invalid, the hearing is closed under RRS 63.4(a)(1).
